subject_uz: Ikkita yo'lovchi liftini (yuk ko'tarish 400 kg) ta'mirlash, sozlash va sinash xizmatlari

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlarni lift jihozlarini ta'mirlash va xizmat ko'rsatish huquqiga ega ixtisoslashgan tashkilot bajarishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Works must be done by a specialised organisation entitled to service and repair lift equipment.
requirements.quote: Работы должны выполняться специализированной организацией, имеющей право на

requirements.summary_uz: Nosozlik qaydnomalari bo'yicha uzellar, elektr jihozlari va boshqaruv shkafini ta'mirlash yoki almashtirish.
requirements.summary_en: Repair or replacement of components, electrical equipment and control cabinet per the defect lists.
requirements.quote: Ремонт или замена изношенных и повреждённых узлов лифтов в соответствии с дефектными

requirements.summary_uz: Ishga tushirish-sozlash va qoidalarga muvofiq sinovlar o'tkazilishi, lift pasportiga yozuv kiritilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Commissioning, rule-based tests and a passport entry for each lift are required.
requirements.quote: Проведение испытаний согласно «Правила устройства и безопасной эксплуатации лифтов»

requirements.summary_uz: Barcha materiallar va ehtiyot qismlar yangi, yaroqli va jihoz xususiyatlariga mos bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: All materials and spare parts must be new, serviceable and compatible with the equipment.
requirements.quote: Все применяемые материалы, запасные части и комплектующие должны быть новыми,

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlar malakali, tegishli ruxsatnomalarga ega xodimlar tomonidan bajarilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Work must be done by qualified staff holding the relevant permits.
requirements.quote: Выполнение работ квалифицированным персоналом, имеющим соответствующие допуски.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlar uchun kafolat muddati kamida 12 oy, shu davrda texnik xizmat va ta'mirlash ham kiradi.
requirements.summary_en: Warranty on the work is at least 12 months, including maintenance and repair during that period.
requirements.quote: Гарантийный срок на выполненные работы и заменённые компоненты составляет не менее 12

requirements.summary_uz: Ish muddati shartnomada belgilanadi va obyekt pudratchiga topshirilgan sanadan hisoblanadi.
requirements.summary_en: The completion term is set by the contract and counted from handing the site to the contractor.
requirements.quote: Срок выполнения работ определяется договором и исчисляется с даты передачи объекта

requirements.summary_uz: Baholash faqat narx bo'yicha (100 foiz); texnik topshiriq bo'limlariga muvofiqlik bo'yicha o'tish bali 11.
requirements.summary_en: Scoring is by price only (100 percent); the pass score on conformity to specification sections is 11.
requirements.quote: Соответствие требованиям Технического задания раздела 3: наличие разрешительных документов для выполнения услуг

requirements.summary_uz: Pudratchi dalolatnomalar, nosozlik qaydnomasi, sinov bayonnomalari va kafolatni taqdim etadi.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor supplies completion acts, a defect list, test protocols and a warranty.
requirements.quote: акты выполненных работ по двум лифтам;

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni cheklovchi jiddiy shart topilmadi.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 437 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 3 ta; savdolarning 48% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 5%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 1 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: No seriously restrictive condition was found in the document.
In the customer's last 437 deals the median number of bidders was 3; 48% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 5%.
Note: 1 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.
